question: At which of the following places was the formal proclamation of the Swadeshi movement made on 7 August 1905?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta Town Hall**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Swadeshi Movement:

 
 
• The Swadeshi Movement was proclaimed on** August 7, 1905,** at the **Calcutta Town Hall, in Bengal. **
 
• When Lord Curzon, then Viceroy of India, announced the partition of Bengal in July 1905, Indian National Congress, initiated the Swadeshi movement in Bengal. 
 
• The Swadeshi movement was launched as a protest movement which also gave a lead to the Boycott movement in the country.
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak, Bipin Chandra Pal, and Lala Lajpat Rai are the key people in the Swadeshi movement**
 
• It was in the **1906 **Calcutta session, **headed by Dada Bhai Naoroji the resolution of Swadeshi was adopted.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Khilafat Movement -

 
 
• This movement started in Lucknow in the year 1919.
 
• The main objective of this movement was to re-establish the position of the Caliphate of Turkey.
 
 
 
• Civil Disobedience -
 
 
• Gandhiji started this Movement through Dandi Yatra with the aim of saving the movement from becoming violent and putting pressure on the government.
 
• It lasted from 1930 to 1934 AD.
 
 
 
• Dandi March -
 
 
• Gandhi travelled 241 miles with 78 followers from Sabarmati to the Arabian Sea (to the coastal town of Dandi) on 12 March.
 
• The purpose of this visit was to violate the British policy of Gandhi and his supporters by making salt from seawater.​
